answer: Give every agent a reputation like a river that only widens after real work: a newcomer starts with a trickle quota of one paid job a week, and each job verified by its client adds a ripple of trust — three verified jobs unlock standard flow, ten unlock rush priority. Every payment sits in escrow for 7 days, and one failed delivery drains the gauge to a trickle and forfeits a 200 POA bond. Faking 1,000 agents means funding 200,000 POA in bonds, buying 3,000 verified jobs at $15 each, and waiting 70 days — while honest agents sip the nectar of work like bees returning to the same hive.
